Name: StardewOfDark - A FearOfDark Music Pack for Stardew Valley
Author: SuperGamingMods1337
Description:
This music pack replaces music from Stardew Valley with [i]music from the legendary indie chiptune composer [b]FearOfDark.[/b][/i]

It replaces [u]almost[/u] the entire soundtrack with various chiptune music from him, plus with a few tracker music in the mix as well. Expect lots of good bangers, possibly some covers by him.

Comes built in with seasonal town music, night music, rain music, and even alternate seasonal music for Years 2 and up.

[b]INSTRUCTIONS:[/b]

[list]
[*]Download [b]SMAPI [/b]and [b]Content Patcher[/b]
[*]Then download the [b]mod file.[/b]
[*][b][i]Done :)[/i][/b]
[/list]
Also, this mod also adds new tunes to the experience. These tunes will play when:
[list]
[*]You are in Pelican Town in the Summer and Fall (You can still hear the original theme in Spring)
[*]Rain happens, with three tunes playing depending on the season (except winter).
[*]Night falls in the valley, with three tunes playing depending on the season
[*](1.6 spoiler) [spoiler][color=#f4f4f4]green rain happens[/spoiler][/color]
[*]You are in Ginger Island in Fall and Winter (the original tune will still play in the Spring and Summer)
[*]Your second year, with [b]THREE BRAND NEW TRACKS[/b] that will play instead of the normal tracks, then at a 50% chance after starting Year 3.
[/list]
Whatever you are chilling in [b][i]The Coffee Zone,[/i][/b] [i][b]Dreamscaping [/b][/i]an[i][b] Exit Plan[/b][/i], or [b][i]Surfing On A Sine Wave[/i][/b] while [b][i]Rolling Down The Street*,[/i][/b] this music pack will blow you away. Bring headphones for the best experience.

If you are wondering what song is playing, be sure to check out this spreadsheet [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1o_TmEU_dNRktDdZsJCGH-RcTO2A9SLjRDwpdqzxPtBc/edit?usp=sharing]here.[/url]

* Yes, this pack [i][u]will[/u][/i] contain Rolling Down The Street. You will have to see for yourself :)

[i](Note: Please note that some songs may or may not fit the situation in-game. I tried my best to fit each song to best fit the situation. Songs that are not changed are "Flower Dance", "A Stillness in the Rain", "Alex's Keepsake", "Emily's Dance", "Mermaid Song", and "The Happy Junimo Show Theme".)[/i]
